prerequisites: Competencies taught in the Algorithms and Data Structures module are recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: Students can apply techniques for developing external data structures and algorithms.
Students can evaluate external data structures regarding runtime, storage space, and throughput.
Students can create data structures within a system-near environment.
Students can handle index structures in commercial database systems.
Students are able to apply scientific working methods in independently identifying, formulating, and solving problems.
Students are able to speak freely about scientific content, both in front of an audience and in a discussion.

syllabus_topics: Concurrency and recovery for index structures

assessment_methods.method: Oral presentation of solutions to at least two exercises

assessment_rules: To acquire credit points, at least 50 percent of the points from the weekly exercises must be achieved, and the solution to at least two exercises must be presented orally. The examination performance consists of an oral examination (individual examination) or a written examination. Grading is based on a scale of 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the M.Sc. Computer Science program.
